headline: 3 dead in mass shooting in Seattle. And, U.S. and Iran pause fighting
context: A mass shooting at a Seattle festival has left three people dead. And, the U.S. and Iran have been exchanging diplomatic messages after nearly tw weeks of intense fighting.
